name: Malphite
title: Shard of the Monolith

Q.name: Seismic Shard
Q.description: Malphite launches a shard of earth at an enemy, dealing 70/120/170/220/270 + 0.6×AP magic damage and Slowing them by 20/25/30/35/40% for 3 seconds. Malphite also steals the amount Slowed, gaining it as Move Speed for 3 seconds.
Q.summary: Malphite sends a shard of the earth through the ground at his foe, dealing damage upon impact and stealing Move Speed for 3 seconds.

W.name: Thunderclap
W.description: Passive: Malphite gains 10/15/20/25/30% Armor (%i:scaleArmor%(varies)). This effect is increased to 30/45/60/75/90% (%i:scaleArmor%(varies)) while Granite Shield is active. Active: Malphite's next Attack deals an additional 30/40/50/60/70 + 0.2×AP + 0.15×armor physical damage and creates an aftershock which deals 15/25/35/45/55 + 0.3×AP + 0.15×armor physical damage %i:OnHit% On-Hit in their direction. His Attacks continue to create aftershocks %i:OnHit% On-Hit for the next 5 seconds.
W.summary: Malphite attacks with such force that it creates a sonic boom. For the next few seconds, his attacks create aftershocks in front of him.

E.name: Ground Slam
E.description: Malphite slams the ground, dealing 60/95/130/165/200 + 0.4×armor + 0.6×AP magic damage and reducing Attack Speed by 30/35/40/45/50% for 3 seconds.
E.summary: Malphite slams the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals magic damage based on his Armor and reduces the Attack Speed of enemies for a short duration.

R.name: Unstoppable Force
R.description: Malphite charges with the force of a landslide, dashing Unstoppably. At the end of the dash, Malphite Knocks Up for 1.5 seconds and deals 200/300/400 + 0.9×AP magic damage.
R.summary: Malphite launches himself to a location at high speed, damaging enemies and knocking them into the air.

Passive.name: Granite Shield
Passive.description: Malphite is shielded by a layer of rock which absorbs damage up to 10% of his maximum Health. If Malphite has not been hit for a few seconds, this effect recharges.
Passive.summary: Malphite is shielded by a layer of rock which absorbs damage up to 10% of his maximum Health. If Malphite has not been hit for a few seconds, this effect recharges.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Armor-stacking tank who engages fights with an unstoppable R knock-up. Wins lanes against AD champions with high armor, Q poke and E attack-speed reduction.
strengths: R: unstoppable dash + area knock-up for engage
W passive armor, tripled while his Granite Shield is up
E reduces attack speed of nearby enemies
Granite Shield passive recharges when he isn't hit
weaknesses: Weak against AP and true damage

curve.items: strong – Plated Steelcaps/Thornmail/Frozen Heart against AD

profile.curveNote: Pokes with Q; real threat from R.

Passive.notes: Shield of 10% max health; recharges when not hit.

W.notes: Passive armor; active empowers next attack with aftershock.

E.notes: Ground slam: damage + attack speed reduction.

profile.windowAgainst: R down: he can't engage. Poke his shield down with AP damage.
checks: Q: shard is point-and-click but travels — confirm projectile blockability.
